results.claim: In the refreshed typed pseudocode, FUN_0021d180 calls FUN_0021bc18 to advance through geometry headers, then calls FUN_0021bf28 for each header.

In the refreshed typed pseudocode, FUN_0021bf28 selects FUN_00128218 when both its effective flags include bit 8 and the current header's bit 0x10 is set; otherwise its shown branch calls FUN_0021c3e0 directly.

FUN_0021c3e0's shown conditional appends an MPG VIF command from its third parameter only if its fifth parameter has bit 8 set; the inspected FUN_00128218 call sites invoke it with flags 2 and 0x2a after masking their incoming flags to 0x100.
These typed pseudocode excerpts do not identify the actual runtime MPG source buffer with overlay-5 or overlay-6, or join that program selection to race94's paused VU PC.
